surface_strategies.borders: 1px solid, sharp edges (rounded-none). Add optical corners/brackets using CSS pseudo-elements where necessary to simulate a targeting HUD.
surface_strategies.shadows: Minimal drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(255,176,0,0.3)] on key interactive accent elements.

SultanInversionTerminal.look: A streaming log feed. Amber text on deep black. Should feel like a hacker console with a blinking cursor at the very end.
SultanInversionTerminal.tech: HTML div with overflow-y-auto, auto-scrolling to bottom. Font: text-xs JetBrains Mono.

BlockchainBalanceChecker.look: Minimalist input field, sharp borders. No rounded corners. Output display in large monospace.
BlockchainBalanceChecker.tech: Input heavily customized (border-b only or strict rectangle). Fetch via JS fetch API from Blockstream. Use Phosphor icons for status.

ChronoFieldVisualizer.look: 3D wireframe or particle field heavily biased towards Amber (#FFB000) and Ion Cyan (#00E5FF) accents.
ChronoFieldVisualizer.tech: Three.js via React Three Fiber (@react-three/fiber). Setup a scene with Post-processing bloom. Should react to slider states visually (rotation speed, particle density, waveform amplitude).

InversionResultPanel.look: The focal point for success output. High contrast. Large font for the collapsed WIF key.
InversionResultPanel.tech: Custom flex panel. COPY button should use a Phosphor icon, turning green momentarily on click to signal success.

LogicKernelControls.look: Tactical sliders. Replace default browser sliders with thin lines and sharp rectangular thumbs.
LogicKernelControls.tech: Shadcn Slider component, heavily overridden via Tailwind CSS to remove generic 'softness' and enforce sharp, brutalist lines.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Interactive elements highlight border to 100% opacity amber. Text gets text-shadow for a 'glow' effect.
motion_and_interactions.active: Slight scale down (0.98) using framer-motion or simple CSS active states.
motion_and_interactions.terminal: Fade-in animation for new log lines. Auto-scroll behavior must be smooth.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load 'Unbounded' and 'JetBrains Mono' from Google Fonts in index.html.
The dashboard MUST be exactly 100vh, ensuring NO scrolling on the main page. Use CSS Grid for the layout structure.

For the Three.js visualizer, use React Three Fiber (`@react-three/fiber` and `@react-three/drei`). Create an abstract rotating mesh or particle system representing the Phi/Gamma field. Bind the 'Logic-Kernel' slider states to the visualizer to modify properties like rotation speed, geometry distortion, or color intensity in real-time.
Implement a mock data generator (setInterval) for the Sultan-Inversion Terminal that pushes random cryptographic-looking strings or 'Delta-Heuristic' status lines every 300-800ms.
Ensure all interactive elements have their defined data-testid attributes.
Strictly avoid 'AI-slop purple'. The palette must stay strictly within Deep Black, Obsidian Grey, Phosphor Amber, and Ion Cyan.
